import os,glob,re
def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def info(p, name):
    inp=p['input']; out=p['output']
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill=Counter(x for r in out for x in r)
    fc=[c for c in fill if c not in (bg,)]  # candidate fill color
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(inp) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg]
    r0,r1=min(q[0] for q in pts),max(q[0] for q in pts)
    c0,c1=min(q[1] for q in pts),max(q[1] for q in pts)
    fills=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(out) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=inp[i][j]]
    print(f'--- {name}: bg={bg} bbox rows {r0}-{r1} cols {c0}-{c1}')
    # classify fills: border or interior
    border=[f for f in fills if f[0] in (r0,r1) or f[1] in (c0,c1)]
    inter=[f for f in fills if f not in border]
    print(' interior fills:', sorted(inter))
    # interior rows/cols with marks
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        m=[(i,j) for j in range(c0,c1+1) if inp[i][j]!=bg]
        im=[j for j in range(c0+1,c1) if inp[i][j]!=bg]
        if m: print(f'  row {i}: marks {m} interior_marks {im}')
    for j in range(c0+1,c1):
        m=[(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) if inp[i][j]!=bg]
        if m: print(f'  col {j}: marks {m}')
for k,p in enumerate(allp): info(p, f'pair{k}')

def analyze(i,o):
    bg=i.flat[0]; marks=np.argwhere(i!=bg)
    r0,r1=marks[:,0].min(),marks[:,0].max(); c0,c1=marks[:,1].min(),marks[:,1].max()
    fills={(r,c) for r in range(i.shape[0]) for c in range(i.shape[1]) if i[r,c]==bg and o[r,c]==2}
    report=[]
    # lines: for each row r in [r0,r1], for each col c in [c0,c1]
    def gaps(seq, idxs, line_desc):
        # idxs: positions along the line where mark present
        if not idxs: return
        for a,b in zip(idxs, idxs[1:]):
            if b-a>1:
                run_before=1; k=a-1
                while k in idxs: run_before+=1; k-=1
                run_after=1; k=b+1
                while k in idxs: run_after+=1; k+=1
                cells=[(r,c) if line_desc[0]=='row' else (c,r) for c in range(a+1,b)]
                f=[p in fills for p in cells]
                report.append((line_desc, cells, f, run_before, run_after))
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        idxs=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if i[r,c]!=bg]
        gaps(idxs, set(idxs), ('row',r))
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        idxs=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if i[r,c]!=bg]
        gaps(idxs, set(idxs), ('col',c))
    return (r0,r1,c0,c1), report

def analyze(i,o):
    bg=i.flat[0]; marks=np.argwhere(i!=bg)
    r0,r1=marks[:,0].min(),marks[:,0].max(); c0,c1=marks[:,1].min(),marks[:,1].max()
    fills={(r,c) for r in range(i.shape[0]) for c in range(i.shape[1]) if i[r,c]==bg and o[r,c]==2}
    report=[]
    def gaps(idxs, line_desc):
        if len(idxs)<2: return
        S=set(idxs); col=rowv=None
        if line_desc[0]=='row': rowv=line_desc[1]
        else: col=line_desc[1]
        for a,b in zip(idxs, idxs[1:]):
            if b-a>1:
                run_before=1; k=a-1
                while k in S: run_before+=1; k-=1
                run_after=1; k=b+1
                while k in S: run_after+=1; k+=1
                if line_desc[0]=='row': cells=[(rowv,x) for x in range(a+1,b)]
                else: cells=[(x,col) for x in range(a+1,b)]
                f=[p in fills for p in cells]
                report.append((line_desc, cells, f, run_before, run_after))
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        gaps([c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if i[r,c]!=bg], ('row',r))
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        gaps([r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if i[r,c]!=bg], ('col',c))
    return (int(r0),int(r1),int(c0),int(c1)), report

data=[]
for name,i,o in pairs_all:
    bb,rep=analyze(i,o)
    print('====',name,'bbox',bb,'gaps',len(rep))
    for ld,cells,f,rb,ra in rep:
        tag='EDGE' if (ld[0]=='row' and ld[1] in (bb[0],bb[1])) or (ld[0]=='col' and ld[1] in (bb[2],bb[3])) else 'int'
        print(f'{tag} {ld} n={len(cells)} filled={sum(f)}/{len(f)} runs={rb},{ra}')
    data.append((name,i,o,bb,rep))

import numpy as np
def analyze_pair(nm, i, o):
    bg = Counter(i.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = [c for c in np.unique(i) if c!=bg]
    mark = mark[0] if len(mark)==1 else None
    rows = np.where((i==mark).any(1))[0]; cols = np.where((i==mark).any(0))[0]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = rows.min(), rows.max(), cols.min(), cols.max()
    fills = {(r,c) for r,c in zip(*np.where(o==2))}
    res=[]
    def line_gaps(fixed, vertical):
        idx = range(r0,r1+1) if vertical else range(c0,c1+1)
        vals = [i[fixed,j] if vertical else i[j,fixed] for j in idx]
        # find bg runs
        segs=[]; s=None
        for k,v in enumerate(vals+[99]):
            if v==bg and s is None: s=k
            elif v!=bg and s is not None:
                segs.append((s,k-1)); s=None
        isborder = (fixed in (r0,r1)) if not vertical else (fixed in (c0,c1))
        hasint = any((vals[k]==mark) for k in range(1,len(vals)-1))

                            glen=b-a+1, fa=fa, fb=fb, filled=filled))
    for rr in range(r0,r1+1): line_gaps(rr, False)
    for cc in range(c0,c1+1): line_gaps(cc, True)

        return segs
    def run(vals, k, d):

    for vert in (False, True):

    from collections import Counter
    i = np.array(grid)
    bg = Counter(i.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = [c for c in np.unique(i) if c != bg][0]
    rows = np.where((i == mark).any(1))[0]
    cols = np.where((i == mark).any(0))[0]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = rows.min(), rows.max(), cols.min(), cols.max()
    o = i.copy()
    def gaps_of(vals):
        segs = []; s = None
        for k, v in enumerate(list(vals) + [99]):
            if v == bg and s is None: s = k
            elif v != bg and s is not None: segs.append((s, k - 1)); s = None
        return segs
    # Fill gaps on any line (row/col within the bbox) that is a bbox border line
    # or contains >= 2 marks at interior positions. Fill color is 2.
    for fixed in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        J = list(range(r0, r1 + 1)); vals = [i[j, fixed] for j in J]
        nint = sum(1 for k, v in enumerate(vals) if v == mark and 0 < k < len(vals) - 1)
        if fixed in (c0, c1) or nint >= 2:
            for a, b in gaps_of(vals):
                for j in range(a, b + 1): o[J[j], fixed] = 2
    for fixed in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        J = list(range(c0, c1 + 1)); vals = [i[fixed, j] for j in J]
        nint = sum(1 for k, v in enumerate(vals) if v == mark and 0 < k < len(vals) - 1)
        if fixed in (r0, r1) or nint >= 2:
            for a, b in gaps_of(vals):

    return o.tolist()
